reading: A program that mints a fresh document identity on every boot is offered its own most recent folder (bindings are ordered by time-ordered document id, so the last of its program is the newest); an exact identity match still wins, and a binding whose document a session already holds is never offered again.

offers.name: a fresh identity is offered the program's newest folder
an exact identity match wins over the newest
a fresh identity whose newest folder is already attached is offered nothing
the booted identity itself being attached offers nothing
a program with no remembered folder is offered nothing

attachTargets.name: a reconnect names the remembered document
a plain folder attach uses the program's own identity
a program without a document attaches nothing
